generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Bidder shall accept all the terms and conditions of the Bid Document

technicalCriterionList.description: List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor, at least one similar work of value not less than Rs 10.25 Lakh in the last five years (i.e.,2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) in any Thermal power station/Major Production/Process Industry. As a proof of this, the bidder should upload a work orders and corresponding work done certificates issued by the Competent Authority (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year 2026-27)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work order and Workdone Certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The Intending Bidder should be a Regular Statutory body with valid certificate issued from competent authority (Director of Factories and Boilers) for conducting inspection of tools and tackles and Pressure Vessels. As a proof of this, Certificate issued by Competent Authority shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- certificate issued from Director of Factories and Boilers

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder in his name should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs 21.0 Lakh. in at least two financial years during the last five years (i.e.,2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload the certified copy of the Profit and Loss account or turnover certificate with UDIN duly certified by the chartered Accountant. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27)
